name: combo-meter
description: Fighting-game combo meter for Claude Code: every clean tool call is a hit, every error breaks the chain. Ranks D to SSS, special moves, and an all-time high score.

sound.title: Sound effects
sound.description: Play the chiptune effects on rank up, specials, breaks and records (macOS plays them; other systems stay silent).

style.title: Band style
style.description: big draws the pixel-art combo counter; compact keeps the band to one line.
